subject.title: feat(nodes): route alerts to the active computer

question: Should active-computer presence and automatic active-first node connection alerts become core OpenClaw behavior?
rationale: The change introduces a new authenticated protocol signal, model-context fact, and automatic cross-node notification policy; correctness tests can validate implementation but cannot authorize that product behavior.

options.title: Sponsor after fix and proof
options.body: Accept the core direction after the acknowledgement defect is fixed and a signed two-Mac run proves primary and fallback behavior.

options.title: Ship presence without routing
options.body: Keep active-node visibility and model context but defer automatic connection-alert routing to a later decision.

options.title: Decline the core direction
options.body: Keep current node behavior and close the feature rather than adding core activity presence and routing policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after fix and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction after the acknowledgement defect is fixed and a signed two-Mac run proves primary and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across every affected owner boundary and owns the linked issue and PR context.
